Find supporting references and previous handover entries
Correct facts and approve final entry and report

tasks.short: Supervise colleagues and provide on-the-job training.

steps.what: Find current procedures for the trainee's duties
Observe performance and decide when to intervene
Demonstrate procedures and guide supervised practice
Give feedback and agree practice goals
Write and verify the training note

tasks.design: Pin approved duty-specific procedures in {DOCS} and configure an {LMS} note with procedure identifiers and status choices. Observation, demonstration and feedback retain all their time; the cashier verifies outcomes before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Scattered procedures and repeated headings in training notes.
tasks.enabler_now: Native links and a short form reduce search and repeated typing.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt coaching when the colleague is confused.
tasks.altitude: Small preparation savings; supervisory rights are unchanged.

reach.task: Track practice goals for new cashiers

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-5 for training-record access and national consultation if applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: pinned procedures and structured notes reduce repeated search and headings without assessing competence automatically.

assumptions: Boundary: focal cashier preparation, supervision, practice, feedback and short training note. Learner participation is unchanged; there is no self-service transfer.

tasks.short: Help in fitting rooms and bag or carry purchases.

steps.what: Monitor fitting rooms and respond to customer needs
Pack purchased items for safe carrying
Carry purchases to the agreed destination

tasks.design: Keep fitting-room assistance, packing and carrying with the cashier. Consider an existing till view in {OTHER}; it does not shorten physical attention or movement, so introduce no software.
tasks.previous_blocker: The output is physical help at the customer's location.
tasks.enabler_now: No software change shortens these actions.
tasks.still_hard: Safe lifting, fragile items and personal assistance.
tasks.human_edge: Handle possessions safely and help considerately.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in the cashier's week or decision rights.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: the named duties require physical assistance; a digital record is not an inherent deliverable.

assumptions: Boundary is the fitting-room, bagging and carrying examples. The duty mix is illustrative, not measured or fitted to the prompt prior.

No write, lookup, report or message occurs in this ordinary assistance workflow. Sale entry and incident reporting are separate tasks, not hidden inside these steps. Confirm any local booking or fitting-room log before extending the boundary.
Inputs are observed needs and physical items. There is no structured input contract or automation. Native till configuration was considered and does not reduce these actions.
Zero upkeep because no tool or additional process is introduced.
unknowns: Whether a local fitting-room register is required
research_questions: Does observation reveal actual record or dispatch work beyond physical help?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Physical assistance stays fully human; no reporting baseline or software saving is assumed.
